chat.empty: Tell it what to help with in your first message. Write any time after that, several things at once if you like.
chat.queued: Delivered once it finishes this reply

fullAccess.title: Bots use Full Access by default
fullAccess.body: System actions no longer ask for your approval, and the same goes for the agents and tasks it creates. Each bot has its own setting, which you can change at any time: click its name at the top.

setup.title: Choose a model for {{name}}
setup.body: It answers with this model and thinking level. You can change them later in the bot's settings. You can send messages once you've chosen.

model.noKey: This model has no key yet. Add one to use it.

sheet.sub: Give it a name, pick an avatar and choose a model. Tell it what to do in the conversation.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.tooLarge: The image is too large: 10 MB at most

add.title: Connect someone else's bot
add.sub: Paste the link they gave you. What you send it goes to them.
add.placeholder: Paste the link they gave you
add.notice: The text and pictures you send leave this Mac and go to {{host}}. It cannot see your other conversations or files, and it cannot operate this computer.
add.noticeLocal: The text and pictures you send go to another service on this Mac ({{host}}). It cannot see your other conversations or files, and it cannot operate this computer.
add.needsCredential: This bot needs a credential before it can be added.

errors.unreachable: No card could be read at this link.
errors.invalid: This link does not lead to a usable card.
errors.unsupported: Its way of connecting is not supported in this version.
errors.moved: The card points at another address ({{host}}); it cannot be added.
errors.changed: The card changed before you confirmed it; read it again.
errors.off: This version cannot add someone else's bot yet.
errors.other: Connecting did not work; please try again.

clear.title: Clear your chat with “{{name}}”?
clear.message: The chat history is cleared and the work it is doing stops. Its files, routines and these settings stay.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.message: Its chat history, the files it made and the work it is doing go with it.

search.noneHint: Search by name or by what was last said

panel.permissionNote: {{desc}}. Applies to this bot only. The agents and tasks it creates run with this mode too, and follow any change at once. Its scheduled tasks run with this mode too, while you are away.
panel.bypassNote: The agents and tasks this bot creates will do the same.
panel.mutedNote: No system notifications, and it doesn't count in the number on the app's icon. Unread still shows in the list.

routines.title: Scheduled tasks
routines.newDraft: Set up a scheduled task for me:
routines.note: Scheduled tasks run on this Mac. They do not run with the lid closed or the Mac off, and catch up once, with the latest, the next time it starts. They keep running after you quit the app, without notifications.

empty.title: No scheduled tasks yet
empty.body: Just tell {{name}}, for example "give me a pre-market brief every morning at 8".

routines.runNowNote: Run now really does the task.

result.skippedWhy: The run before it was still going

external.wordsOnly: Their bot takes words, pictures and quotes only; the attachments were not sent.
external.firstTitle: What you send “{{name}}” leaves this Mac
external.firstBody: What you send {{host}} goes to them.
external.firstLocal: What you send {{host}} goes to another service on this Mac.
external.moved: Their card points at another address; the last one is still in use.
external.unreachable: Their card has not been readable for a while; the last one is still in use.
external.rereadHint: If they move it or change how it signs in, read the card again to follow.
external.schemeChanged: They now ask for {{auth}}. Enter the new credential below before it can be messaged again.
external.schemeDropped: They no longer ask for a credential. Confirm to carry on.

credential.keep: Saved — type a new one to replace it
